title: Outcome of a Gitea connection write or check
description: outcome: written (tea's file now holds the change), unchanged (it already did; a repeated request after a lost reply is observed, not replayed), absent (the entry to remove was already gone) or checked. api is the base's /user answer for this token now, given only by connect, replace and check; it is never Git readiness, which connection.git observes separately. A connect whose helper registration failed still answers with the connection and its git state, so the page offers repair rather than a working connection. Refusals are fixed error codes in the error shape: nothing was written.
